svg.text: Red Hat publishes the advisory; ring 0 takes it within a day, ring 1 in the weekly window, ring 2 in the monthly window or an emergency one.

svg.text: A failed health check stops the play

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The failed batch is patched and the rest of production is not: fix forward on that batch or roll it back, then continue.

svg.text: 3 rings, 1 play, 0 unplanned reboots. Controls supported: SI-2, SI-2(2), SI-2(3), CM-3, CM-4; CIS Controls v8 7.3 and 7.4.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Red Hat artwork.
